moments.title: Premier League Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season is expected to kick off this weekend, bringing top-flight football back to the UK.

angles.name: General Excitement
angles.copy: Football's back! The Premier League season kicks off this weekend. Who are you backing for the title?

angles.name: Team Focus
angles.copy: Ready for the Premier League return? London teams are gearing up for action this weekend!

moments.title: Bloodstock Festival Rocks Derbyshire
moments.blurb: Bloodstock Open Air, the UK's premier independent metal festival, takes over Catton Park in Derbyshire from August 6-9, 2026.

angles.name: Festival Vibe
angles.copy: Bloodstock is GO! Catton Park is about to get loud as the metal festival kicks off this Thursday.

angles.name: Calling Rock Fans
angles.copy: If you're heading to Bloodstock this weekend, prepare for some serious headbanging! Who are you most excited to see?

moments.title: Roots Picnic Debuts in London
moments.blurb: The globally celebrated Roots Picnic festival makes its international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl, London, on August 8-9, 2026, blending hip hop, music, and culture.

angles.name: London Debut
angles.copy: Huge news for London! The legendary Roots Picnic festival lands at Crystal Palace Bowl this weekend for its international debut. Get ready!

angles.name: Music & Culture
angles.copy: Roots Picnic is bringing world-class hip hop and culture to London's Crystal Palace Bowl this weekend. Who's got their tickets?

moments.title: Edinburgh Fringe Festival Underway
moments.blurb: The world's largest arts festival, the Edinburgh Fringe, is in full swing throughout August, attracting performers and audiences globally.

angles.name: Festival Buzz
angles.copy: Edinburgh is buzzing! The Fringe Festival is well underway, with thousands of shows and a vibrant atmosphere taking over the city.

angles.name: UK-wide appeal
angles.copy: From comedy to drama, the Edinburgh Fringe Festival is showcasing incredible talent all month. Who's planning a trip up north?

moments.title: Ian Broudie of The Lightning Seeds turns 68
moments.blurb: Ian Broudie, the mastermind behind The Lightning Seeds and producer, celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Main Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to Ian Broudie! The man behind The Lightning Seeds gave us some iconic 90s anthems. What's your favourite?

moments.title: Geri Halliwell turns 54

angles.name: Main Birthday
angles.copy: It's Ginger Spice's birthday! Geri Halliwell turns 54 on Thursday. What's your favourite Spice Girls memory?

moments.title: Iron Maiden's Bruce Dickinson turns 68

angles.name: Metal Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Scream for me, birthday boy! Iron Maiden's incredible vocalist Bruce Dickinson turns 68 on Friday. What's your favourite Maiden track?

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Happy 65th Birthday to The Edge! The U2 guitarist's distinctive sound has shaped decades of music. What's your favourite U2 song?

angles.name: Pop Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 28th Birthday to the one and only Shawn Mendes! Send your birthday wishes and tell us your favourite track!
